articles.title: UN says IMO confirms 25 seafarer deaths since Iran war began
articles.summary:
UN says IMO confirms 25 seafarer deaths since Iran war began

As many as 25 seafarers have been killed in 134 confirmed maritime incidents across the Strait of Hormuz and the wider Middle East since the US and Israeli started war on Iran in February, according to Khalid Khiari, UN Assistant Secretary-General Khaled for the Middle East, Asia and the Pacific.

Briefing the UN Security Council on Friday, Khiari cited figures from the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) covering incidents recorded up to November 11.

He said October saw the highest monthly number of incidents involving commercial shipping since February, warning that continued disruption was driving up energy, transport and insurance costs and threatening global food security.

“This situation cannot be allowed to become the new normal,” Khiari said, calling for an immediate end to attacks on civilian vessels and the restoration of safe maritime navigation.

Bahrain’s representative told the meeting that about 1,600 vessels had been affected by disruptions in the waterway, leaving more than 23,000 seafarers stranded aboard their ships.

articles.title: Mossad chief in Washington for talks on Iran, report says
articles.summary:
Mossad chief in Washington for talks on Iran, report says

Roman Gofman, chief of Israeli spy agency Mossad and one of Benjamin Netanyahu's closest confidants, was in Washington on Friday for talks with senior Trump administration officials about the war in Iran, Axios reported, citing three sources with knowledge of the matter.

 The visit comes as the Israeli prime minister is pressing President Trump to resume the war against Iran. Axios said Gofman was to meet CIA Director John Ratcliffe and later expected to travel to Miami to meet White House envoy Steve Witkoff.

Mossad, the CIA and the White House declined to comment, Axios said.

Meanwhile Israel's Channel 12 news reported that Gofman’s trip was not disclosed to Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot in his Thursday security briefing with Netanyahu.

Trump, who suffered a defeat in the midterm elections, has resisted the pressure to resume strikes on Iran. Also, on Friday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that further military action against Iran was unnecessary because the "economic pain" inflicted by the US sanctions on Tehran "was so great".

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává kritická kvůli probíhajícím vojenským operacím v Gaze a jižním Libanonu, eskalujícím incidentům spojeným s Íránem a obavám z jeho jaderného programu. Zprávy o útocích na pozice USA, eskalace v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu a nárůst vnitřního napětí v Izraeli a Iráku udržují rizikovou prémii na maximálních úrovních.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains critical due to ongoing military operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon, escalating incidents involving Iran, and growing concerns over its nuclear program. Reports of attacks on US positions, escalation in the Strait of Hormuz, and rising internal tensions in Israel and Iraq keep the risk premium at maximum levels.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračování vojenských operací v Gaze a Libanonu spolu s diplomatickým tlakem na Írán ze strany IAEA. Riziko odvetných útoků v Perském zálivu a Levantě zůstává extrémně vysoké.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, military operations in Gaza and Lebanon are expected to continue alongside diplomatic pressure on Iran by the IAEA. The risk of retaliatory attacks in the Persian Gulf and Levant remains extremely high.

archive.security_status_cs: Konflikt v regionu zůstává vysoce eskalovaný, přičemž Íránem podporované síly a námořní incidenty v Hormuzském průlivu ohrožují energetickou infrastrukturu a lodní dopravu. Izraelské operace v Gaze a Západním břehu pokračují navzdory příměřím, což prohlubuje humanitární krizi a politické napětí.
archive.security_status_en: The regional conflict remains highly escalated, with Iran-backed proxies and maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz threatening energy infrastructure and shipping lanes. Israeli operations in Gaza and the West Bank persist despite ceasefires, deepening the humanitarian crisis and political tensions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně íránského jaderného programu a zvýšené bezpečnostní opatření v oblasti Perského zálivu kvůli námořním incidentům. Napětí v Gaze a na Západním břehu zůstane na kritické úrovni.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers regarding Iran's nuclear program and heightened security measures in the Persian Gulf are expected due to maritime incidents. Tensions in Gaza and the West Bank will remain at a critical level.
